column1: # The ten-point cube of r*(3,3): is there a 3-uniform family on 10 points with
# 28 members, no three pairwise disjoint, point degree <= 9, pair degree <= 3?
# Sum of degrees is 84, so the deficiencies 9 - d_v sum to 6; sorting the points
# by degree, each cube is a partition of 6 (eleven cubes).  Solver: OR-Tools
# CP-SAT 9 via tools/cube10.py, one worker per cube.  K = lex-leader prefix
# length used for the equal-degree transpositions (20 = weak, 56 = full);
# B = 16 adds the kernel-proved cut "members disjoint from a member number at
# most 16" (TauThree.tau_three_bound / TwoCoverSharp / a star).  A cube listed
# UNKNOWN at its cap and again INFEASIBLE was re-run with the stronger settings;
# every cube ends INFEASIBLE.  Second opinion: SCIP via tools/cube10_mip.py with
# the same lex constraints and cut, where it finished.  Session N+16
